# 713 Garage Door -- Houston Garage Door Repair

> Emergency garage door repair, spring replacement, opener service, and installation across Greater Houston, including Sugar Land, Katy, The Woodlands, Memorial, The Heights, and Pearland.

## Services
- Garage Door Repair (residential and commercial)
- Garage Door Spring Repair (torsion and extension)
- Garage Door Opener Repair (all major brands including LiftMaster, Chamberlain, Genie)
- New Garage Door Installation
- Commercial Garage Door Service
- 24/7 Emergency Garage Door Service

## Service Area
Greater Houston Metro, including Harris County, Fort Bend County, and Montgomery County. Specific neighborhoods served: The Heights, Memorial, Sugar Land, Katy, The Woodlands. Adjacent areas: Pearland, Cypress, Spring, Tomball, Humble, Kingwood, River Oaks, West University, Bellaire.

## Common Issues We Handle
- Broken garage door springs (most common emergency)
- Garage door opener not working
- Garage door off track
- Bent or damaged panels
- Cable replacement
- Roller and hinge replacement
- Hurricane and wind damage repair
- Houston humidity-related corrosion and rot

## Houston-Specific Considerations
Houston's humid subtropical climate accelerates spring corrosion and panel damage on wooden doors. Hurricane season (June through November) creates demand for wind-rated reinforcement. Summer heat strains opener motors, shortening their lifespan compared to drier climates.
